programme.title: What Would You Do?
programme.desc: Using hidden cameras, host John Quiñones observes and comments on how ordinary people behave when they are confronted with dilemmas that require them either to take action or to walk by and mind their own business. Various scenarios are created that force people to make split-second -- and often surprising -- decisions, and variations of the situation (such as changing the genders, races or clothing of the people involved) are often featured to see if different reactions are elicited. Examples of situations on the show include a waitress being harassed by her boss, and a drunken valet trying to park cars.

programme.title: The Price Is Right
programme.desc: "Come on down!" "The Price Is Right" -- hosted by Bob Barker until 2007 and Drew Carey thereafter -- features a wide variety of games and contests with the same basic challenge: Guess the prices of everyday (or not-quite-everyday) retail items. Four contestants, all of whom are seated in one of the wildest audiences in daytime game-show history, are called to the stage to play a preliminary pricing round. That winner joins the host on stage for one of more than 70 different pricing games. After three such games, the contestants spin a big wheel -- hoping to get as close to $1 as possible -- in the "Showcase Showdown." The two highest winners of that round advance to the final, where prizes could be cars or roomsful of furniture. A trio of models presents the prizes.

programme.title: CBS News Sunday Morning
programme.desc: The sparkling notes of a trumpet fanfare and the familiar logo of the sun alert viewers that it's time for CBS's Sunday morning staple. Journalist Jane Pauley helms the show, taking over hosting duties from Charles Osgood, who spent 22 years on the job. A morning talk show, this program airs at a different pace and focuses much of its attention on the performing arts. After a quick update of the day's news and national weather, correspondents offer longer-length segments on a variety of topics, from architecture to ballet to music to pop culture to politics.

programme.title: Yellowjackets
programme.desc: "Yellowjackets" tells the narrative of a team of wildly talented high-school girls soccer players who survive a plane crash deep in the Ontario wilderness. The series chronicles their descent from a complicated but thriving team to warring, cannibalistic clans, while also tracking the lives they have attempted to piece back together. Sophie Nélisse, Jasmin Savoy Brown, Sophie Thatcher and Sammi Hanratty star as the teenagers, while Melanie Lynskey, Tawny Cypress, Christina Ricci and Juliette Lewis portray their adult counterparts as they reveal the truth about their survival 25 years later.

programme.title: What Would You Do?
programme.desc: Using hidden cameras, host John Quiñones observes and comments on how ordinary people behave when they are confronted with dilemmas that require them either to take action or to walk by and mind their own business. Various scenarios are created that force people to make split-second -- and often surprising -- decisions, and variations of the situation (such as changing the genders, races or clothing of the people involved) are often featured to see if different reactions are elicited. Examples of situations on the show include a waitress being harassed by her boss, and a drunken valet trying to park cars.

programme.title: The Breakdown With Peyton and Kuechly

programme.title: Live: NFL GameDay Morning
programme.desc: Rich Eisen leads a cast of NFL talent through four hours of pregame hype, prepping viewers for the kickoffs of Sunday's games. Joining Eisen is Super Bowl champion Kurt Warner, former NFL head coach Steve Mariucci, and special guests each week to break down the matchups. The latest news from around the league, reports from game sites and interviews with players and coaches are featured, and insider Ian Rapoport provides late-breaking news.

programme.title: NFL GameDay Live
programme.desc: Expanding on NFL Network's "GameDay" programming on Sundays during football season, "GameDay Live" updates viewers on what's happening throughout the league. Beginning with kickoff of early-afternoon events and continuing throughout late-afternoon contests, the studio show offers nearly immediate highlights of scoring and other notable plays. But the program is about more than the action; it intersperses highlights of press conferences, interviews with players and coaches, and live reports by announcers at game sites.

programme.desc: Baby, it might be cold outside, and the springtime sounds of bats hitting balls are months away. What better way for baseball fans to cure the winter blues than to gather around the "Hot Stove" and warm up to the news of the offseason? Instituting sweeping, radical changes to the government -- including the dissolution of Congress and the revoking of the Constitution -- Hammond somehow manages to bring order to the country through dictatorship, along with world peace.

Staying true to his word, John weds Maggie and begins a successful career, thanks largely to his savvy wife. The couple's relationship is placed in jeopardy, though, when John faces temptation in the form of the lovely aristocrat Lady Sybil Tenterden (Madge Evans).

programme.title: She Married Her Boss

Fearful of losing Julia's talents, Richard marries her and demands she sort out his messy home life with his young daughter and overbearing sister. programme.title: Fame

The youngsters grapple with heavy issues such as homosexuality, abortion, attempted suicide and illiteracy. On top of their unique struggles, the students must deal with the mundane pressures of adolescence like homework, heartbreak and rejection.

The Gestapo colonel in charge of the investigation presses his fiancée, Karen Hauen, to help and, with reluctance, she agrees. After befriending Bill, Karen discovers how he receives the information, but when she also learns who provides it, she is exposed for the first time to the brutal tactics of her government.

The snag in the cop's plan comes when his boss wrongly accuses the father of Dixon's love interest, Morgan, of the murder.

Taking pity on her, Denver offers Nancy his apartment as a place to write while his wife, Iris (Gene Tierney), is away. Shortly after, Nancy is found dead in his bathroom, apparently murdered, and Denver is, of course, the main suspect. As rumors swirl about his involvement with Nancy, Denver decides to search for her killer himself.

programme.title: The Neptune Factor

Along with a crew that includes Dr. Leah Jansen (Yvette Mimieux) and diver Don MacKay (Ernest Borgnine), Blake attempts to save the scientists from the unexplored depths, while encountering gigantic sea creatures that threaten their survival.

programme.title: Eyewitness

There's been a murder in the office building, and Tony suspects that Daryll may have insight into the crime, a notion that he furthers to stay close to her. However, when those behind the killing begin to think that Daryll really knows something, they target both him and Tony to keep their secrets hidden.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: Do our memories define our identity? If we are merely the sum of our experiences, what do we become if those experiences are lost? Hope Wilson (Robbie Chong) faces this question when she meets a man who has purposely erased his own memories.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: Courtesy of a freak accident (and The Outer Limits), an agoraphobe (Jane Adams) begins to hear the private thoughts of all of the tenants in her building...the good, the bad and the steamy. And it seems at least one of them may want to kill her.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: A scientist -- who is also a religious zealot (David Ogden Stiers) -- secretly implants an embryo created with DNA from the Shroud of Turin into a young woman (Samantha Mathis) in order to scientifically engineer the Second Coming of Christ.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: The Outer Limits come to Victorian Whitechapel when a London doctor (Cary Elwes) races to capture the alien creature responsible for the Jack the Ripper murders. But when the alien frames the good doctor for the murders, his time may be up.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: The son (Saul Rubinek) of a concentration camp survivor (Peter Boretski) gets some unique help in proving the guilt of a former Nazi (Jan Rubes) living in the U.S....courtesy of a time traveler (Alex Daikun) and, of course, The Outer Limits.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: The planets Earth and Dregocia struggle to re-establish a fragile trust after a summit goes tragically wrong. Can a diplomat (Marcia Cross) calm the hawkish nature of both species…and can she overcome her own prejudices to save both worlds?

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: A meek anthropologist (Leland Orser) develops a serum for genetic dominance and tests it on himself. Now his newfound confidence takes complete control of him, turning him into an irrational, overly aggressive troglodyte! Can he reverse the process?

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: The Haven is a high-tech apartment building which is run by supercomputer and almost completely eliminates the need for human contact. But when things begin to go wrong, neighbors who have never met must learn to work together in order to survive!

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: When a scientist's (Kevin Nealon) experiment unintentionally creates a rift in the space-time continuum, he suddenly find himself caught in a time loop and soon begins to suspects sabotage. Terri Hawkes, Jennifer Copping and Ronny Cox also star.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: A boy (Adam Hann-Byrd) , picked on by high-school bullies and neglected by his own father (Daniel Hugh Kelley), finds comfort in an alien (Chris Potter) who has crash-landed on earth. But is the alien what he claims to be? Never…in The Outer Limits.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: In a world dominated by alien invaders, a cynical American cafe owner (Nathan Fillion) must decide if he will risk his life to help an old lover fight for Earth or if he is happy not rocking the political boat. Derek de Lint also stars.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: When Detective Terry Russo (Megan Gallagher) is called to investigate a double murder, she discovers she may be solving not one crime, but possibly hundreds. And that the culprit -- or culprits -- may not be human at all. Michael Riley also stars.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: A convicted murderer is turned loose only to be hunted by the sister of his victim as part the hottest show on television, Judgment Day, which allows the family members -- and the at home audience -- to act as judge, jury and executioner!

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: An ex-con who had been serving time for spousal abuse is bent on revenge against his wife. He purchases a strange handgun from a gun dealer and finds this is no ordinary weapon and, in fact, he becomes quite attached to it…literally.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: A device that allows people to change their appearance helps a nerdy guy become the mirror image of his hunky co-worker.. Now arrogant with his new-found good looks, the former nerd experiences a life like never before…and now he wants to keep it.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: An invisible alien race that inhabits the energy systems of a deserted spaceship envelopes the crew of a salvage team, responding to the empty vessel's distress signal, in a web of paranoia, suspicion and murder. Michael Shanks stars.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: When a scientist uses his time machine to travel into the future, he discovers his wife lying dead in a pool of blood and a man fleeing the scene. Determined save her, he uses the time machine to go back in time...but is her death inevitable?

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: A blind man (Mackenzie Astin) regains his sight only to be used by the government for his unique ability to see an alien from another dimension who has been trapped on Earth and yearns to return home. But the government has other plans for her.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: A veterinarian (Jessica Tuck) in a small farming community becomes alarmed when a genetically-engineered corn seed, intended to produce faster, larger yields of corn, produces something far more alarming …human mutations! Len Cariou also stars.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: After losing his wife and son in a horrific car accident some twenty years earlier, a scientist (Joel Gray) uses advanced technology to build the perfect robotic version of his son. But perfection is not always so perfect...in The Outer Limits.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: Due to dwindling resources in the future, the world consists of "Alphas" and "Betas" who are alternately put in stasis for 72 hour periods, all in service to the "Elites," who lord over the Alphas and the Betas...But a resistance is coming.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: When a man arrives at al UFO convention with part of an alien ship, it throws the annual gathering of "true believers" into chaos and leads to a conspiracy, a cover-upï¿½and murder. But who is conspiring with whom? And what are they covering up?

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: After being brought back from death, a woman (Laura Leighton) discovers she was one part of a pair of conjoined twins, the other lost during pregnancy. And now that twin, living dormant in her body for all these years, wants a life of her own.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: Tom (Tate Donovan) and Wendy (Gabrielle Miller) are the perfect couple, happy and very much in love. But at night, Tom has terrible memory flashes about being stuck in a burning building The nightmares, however, aren't real…and neither is Tom.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: After the plane he is traveling in is struck by lightning, a Presidential candidate is visited by a time traveler who tells him that he needs to escape impending death because his presidency is the key to preventing an apocalyptic future.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: The crew of a space salvage ship is awakened from hyper-sleep when they come across a mysterious object floating through space. They soon discover the pod contains a tyrant, in stasis, who was banished from Earth for crimes against humanity.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: A man travels back to his home town in order to investigate his brother's murder, allegedly at the hands of his brother's wife. He quickly discovers his hometown has drastically changed...and the residents seem to be under some form of mind control.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: A preacher (Gary Busey), who lost his faith when his wife died, performs staged healing miracles at tent revivals until he finds his faith -- and livelihood -- being tested as never before by the appearance of a mysterious wheelchair-bound man.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: Two friends re-enacting the Battle of Gettysburg unwittingly find themselves transported back in time and taken prisoner by a deranged Confederate colonel (Meatloaf) who might not only endanger their future…but the future of the country as well.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: A teenage boy (Joseph Gordon-Levitt) suspects that the tenant (Judd Nelson) now taking up residence in his mother's backyard apartment is actually an alien on a deadly mission…a suspicion that puts the boy and his mother in grave danger.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: An anarchist (Frank Whaley), who was once rabidly pro-technology, threatens to blow up the central computers that control the world. As he negotiates with Pete Yastremski (John Amos) to surrender, we discover what led him down this dark path.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: When the leader of an Arctic exploration team kills two colleagues, psychologist Jack Burrell (William Cummins) is sent up to counsel the staff, including an old "friend" (Robert Sean Leonard), and to find the cause of an infectious psychosis.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: Time-traveler Dr. Theresa Givens (Amanda Plummer) faces the death penalty for using her time machine in a future where all technology is banned due to a devastating nuclear holocaust some 20 years earlier. Charlton Heston also stars.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: An overworked father who wants to relieve the tension in his home due to the demands of his job orders a robot to keep house and perform other chores. Much to the father's surprise, the robot starts to replace him as head of the household.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: A military colonel travels into the past from a plagued-ridden future where billions have died from a deadly virus. His mission: track down Patient Zero, the woman who had all three strains of DNA that produced the virus and assassinate her.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: A couple and their friend join a mysterious religious sect in order to lead a more spiritual existence and find a new direction in life. They soon learn, however, that their new-found direction may take them further than they ever thought possible.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: Young and artistic Claire Linkwood, who struggles financially to make ends meet, volunteers for a surrogate mother program. But after the embryo is successfully implanted at the clinic, she begins to have nightmares of a most "alien" nature.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: The lone survivor (Jere Burns) of a space shuttle disaster discovers he's greatly transformed since surviving the crash. For one, his body seems to be indestructible, and he embraces a new-found humanity…courtesy of The Outer Limits.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: Mona Lisa, an android who was created to spy and kill, is designed with superior intelligence. But it is that superior intellect which allows her to evolve, leading her to question the morality of her prime directive...and her own existence.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: A biogeneticist clones successfully his wife, who is near death in a coma with no expectation of survival. But when his real wife suddenly awakens from her coma, he finds life with not one, but two wives may be quite complicated.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: A man (Enrico Colantoni) has second thoughts about a process that transmits a copy of a person light years away but requires that the human "shell" left behind be destroyed in order to maintain a balance in the Universe.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: An unemployed man wanders into a curio shop owned by a shape-shifting alien and is offered a rather unique wallet...one that fills with the money of anyone the man comes in physical contact with. However, if it's too good to be true, it often is.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: A dying scientist (Joanna Going) makes it her mission to save a mutant "child" -- a link to another dimension of time and space -- from those scientists who seek fame and from shadowy government forces that desire to exploit it.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: A four-person space crew travels through a wormhole that lands them in an unknown universe where Native American Astrophysicist Callie Whitehorse Landau experiences bizarre hallucinations that reveal the true nature of the entire universe.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: When an alien seed travels through space and lands on Earth in a rooftop garden, the exotic "flower" it spawns turns out to be an alluring woman who consumes the life and energy out of human victims in the attempt to perpetuate her species on Earth.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: After a botched military experiment some four years earlier resulted in the death of one of the test subjects, a doctor now believes the deceased test subject's vengeful spirit is able to jump from one body to another…and is after her.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: In an effort to help the mentally ill, a psychiatrist (Jamie Lunar) creates a device that allows her to enter the subconscious of her patients. But when things go wrong, she finds that her own sanity -- and possibly her life -- may be in danger.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: A time traveler recruits a young woman from present day to join a team of time travelers-for-hire, but when she ends up attempting to change her own past, doing irreparable damage to the present and the future, the institute must race to stop her.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: When an alien abducts five students and transports them to a reproduction of their school, it informs them that they are part of a grand experiment. But as part of that experiment, together they must decide which of the five should be killed.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: A circuit court judge (Dennis Haysbert) agrees to preside over a case on a colonized planet that has never had any organized rule of law. On a world in which humans and aliens live side by side, he finds his first case is one of murder.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: A desperate high school wrestling coach gives his team an untested performance-enhancing inhalant. Of course, the team suddenly starts winning…but their victory may be short-lived as the drug comes with killer side effects.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: An employee of a computer company uncovers a plot by its CEO/founder to take control of the world's computer network by having computers communicate at a more sentient level and, if successful, set himself up for world domination.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: A woman who was abducted by aliens 17 years earlier tries to move past the mental scars, especially for the sake of her daughter, and finds love with a new teacher at her daughter's school. But she soon learns he is not the man he appears to be.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: A rogue android who is part of the crew on Ganymede outpost threatens to destroy Earth's last hope of survival, claiming that human beings are no better than an infestation in the universe and not worthy of survival. And perhaps he is right….

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: A test to find the right soldier for a secret mission pushes the limits of each of the candidates. Placed in seemingly real and very dangerous situations, the candidates soon find the line between reality and simulation inexorably blurred.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: Beau Bridges stars in this bone-chilling thriller. A ride of harrowing suspense, this taut film is packed with heart-stopping tension that faithfully fulfills the tradition of the ground-breaking series upon which it is based, the "Outer Limits.".

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: Can jealousy be a good thing? Not for Rachel Rose, a physical therapist whose life is threatened when she come between her paraplegic patient and his amorous robotic companion who is programmed to remove any obstacle that stands in her way.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: Two brothers wrestle for control of their father's million-dollar pharmaceutical company. But when one brother discovers a drug which may hold the secret to eternal life, the battle for control becomes a rapid trip toward self-destruction.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: A dying race of aliens come to Earth to stop its own extinction...by reanimating human corpses. But a government doctor (Mykelti Williamson) senses that there may be more to their plans than mere survival! D. W. Moffett and Rae Dawn Chong also star.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: An experiment at St. Peter's Hospital threatens the natural order of things when an embittered billionaire (William Hickey) pays brilliant cardiologist (Bruce Davidson) to help him cheat death. But is death willing to be cheated so easily?

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: Aggie (Thora Birch) is an outcast at her elementary school because strange things seem to happen around her. When she is suspended from school, her parents hire a nanny who seems to good to be true. Will they lose their only child to keep her safe?

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: When a college student (Josh Brolin) experimenting with time travel takes job with a prestigious lab, he doesn't realize that the lab's billionaire owner understands completely the financial and political benefits of seeing into the future.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: Ben Kohler's (Sam Robards) life is saved after having an experimental microchip implanted in his brain, but when he starts seeing murders as if through the eyes of the killer, it becomes clear that something is desperately wrong.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: When Father Anton, a priest who has been questioning his faith, stumbles and hits his head, he suddenly begins to see demons all about him. When those demons bestow upon him the power over life and death, he uses it...but nothing comes without a cost.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: When Sharon Rosman's son is abducted his 6-year-old sister in the only witness but is far too traumatized to speak. When psychologist John Holland comes to work with the young girl, she tells him it was the boogeyman...from under the bed.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: Dropped out of space by a chunk of dark matter, pilot Paul Stein (John Heard) discovers a derelict ship lost ten years ago with all hands, including his long-lost brother. Only it seems that the crew may not quite be dead...or alive.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: Henry Marshall (Frank Whaley) is a greedy man. Recently released from prison, Marshall has learned little from his experiences. But an encounter with alien beings (Rebecca De Mornay and John Savage) may just teach him a thing or two.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: On a remote planet, Major Stokes (Robert Patrick), one of Earth's best warriors, has been captured by aliens and placed in a cell with a woman who is slowly being transformed into one of the aliens. Can he escape before he suffers a similar fate?

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: Hanna Velasic (Alyssa Milano) has a killer body...literally! When the formerly chaste beauty is taken over by a mysterious force, he appetite for men becomes insatiable...and murderous. Can her loving boyfriend put an end to her killing spree?

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: When a group of astronauts returning to Earth after an expedition to Mars discover what appears to be a dangerous alien life form on their ship, they must decide whether to return to Earth or sacrifice themselves for the sake of all humanity?

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: To cure his cancer, a man (Peter Outerbridge) secretly injects himself with experimental nanobots that his scientist friend (Richard Thomas) developed. The trial is successful -- too successful -- when the super 'bots try to create a superhuman!

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: Jennifer (Marlee Matlin), deaf since birth, has had a revolutionary implant in her ear, to help her hear for the first time. The device doesn't help her to hear normal conversation and sounds, but she does hear...something...from The Outer Limits.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: When a robot named Adam is accused of killing his own creator, it's up to a civil liberties attorney (Leonard Nimoy) to defend him. Is Adam capable of murder? Or did a military retrofit of the docile robot turn him into a ruthless killing machine?

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: Lynda is a grieving mother who feels her son's spirit is haunting her. Levi is a scientist out to prove that ghosts do not exist. Can her faith and his skepticism come together to solve the mystery of a haunted house and a senseless death?

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: An environmentally friendly U.S. Senator's life changes when, after a freak accident, he suddenly starts to believe he is an alien in disguise, with a "mission" to surreptitiously reconfigure the Earth's atmosphere. But is it for the better?

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: Randall Strong (Gordon Clapp) is on a mission to convince the US Military that aliens are threatening Earth, but committee Chairman Thornwell (Daniel J. Travanti) seems to be Strong's biggest stumbling block. Could Thornewll be one of... "them"?

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: FBI agent Jamie Pratt (Michelle Forbes) investigates a perplexing case when her best friend becomes a killer's next victim. The mystery takes her through five decades of time, where reality changes at each and every turn...in the Outer Limits.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: Life on Earth has been wiped out by biological warfare, with androids the only survivors. Two such androids (Heather Graham, Dana Ashbrook) recreate a human from DNA and must protect him from a military force which wants humankind annihilated.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: Howard (Alan Ruck) and Joanne (Catherine Mary Stewart) are happily expecting their first child. They live in a world where genetic alteration is rampantly purchased on the black market...but nothing comes without a price in The Outer Limits.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: After intercepting a strange phone call, a tenacious reporter (Ally Sheedy) finds herself in a deadly game of cat and mouse. The only clues to the mystery: a strange man with violet eyes and missing persons who leave behind a pile of purple ash.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: When an accident puts Dr. Stein's (Mark Hamill) colleague, Rachel, in a coma, he uses his newly-created invention to reach her brain and tell her he loves her. However, Stein discovers that love takes strange turns when it enters the virtual world.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: After flashbacks of an alien abduction lead him to attempt suicide, Eddie Wexler (Michael O'Keefe) is institutionalized, with a doctor who seems intent on forcing him to relive his "memories." Is Eddie insane? Or is the doctor more than he seems?

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: As he celebrates his first anniversary, Norman (Matt Frewer) thinks he's the luckiest man alive. But suddenly, his lovely wife doesn't seem the same and he can't stand to be around her. Is he going crazy or are his instincts telling him something?

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: Problem child Rusty (Ryan Phillippe) finds himself thrown into a private school bent on straightening him out with some unorthodox methods. Rusty has eluded their control so far, but can he escape from this prison of the mind?

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: On the first day of his presidency, Charles Halsey (Robert Foxworth) is faced with the first galactic foreign policy decision. As aliens are approaching Earth, the peace-loving president must determine if they are invaders or benevolent explorers.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: In a bizarre twist of fate, Nancy McDonald (Bonnie Bedelia) receives a distress call from Lindy (Chad Willett), a former lover, who was lost in space twenty years earlier. And he has a message: He's alive...and he desperately needs her help.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: A man (James Wilder) finds himself in what seems to be a refuge in a post-apocalyptic world, lorded over by a sadistic industrialist (M. Emmet Walsh) who pits his guests against one another for enjoyment...but all is not what it seems to be.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: When a lonely physics professor Stanley Hurst (Michael Gross) realizes the sun is going to burn out, he knows that he and humanity have only a few hours to live. In that time, Stan resolves to make up for lost years.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: Howie (Neil Patrick Harris), a boy with intellectual disabilities, is the last unaffected person in a town overrun by a strange, parasitic madness. On his own for the first time, Howie has only himself to rely upon if he wants to save his sister!

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: After a friend's betrayal cost him his Army career, Lee Taylor (Costas Mandylor) helps a self-styled militia Major hijack an Army shipment. Expecting missiles, they find a mysterious cargo and a lone Army Guard who warns of its deadly capability.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: Convicted of a murder he didn't commit, Linden Stiles can either accept execution or become the subject of a military experiment. Choosing to live, he finds himself slowly dehumanized by the alien DNA that has been injected into him.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: With Earth under alien rule, humanity has been programmed into slavery. A band of rebels kidnap Evan (Erich Anderson), one of the alien leader's slaves. After a twist of fate, Evan agrees to assassinate his former master...with devastating results.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: When three young women age and die within hours, a small town is turned upside down. How does Helen (Maxine Miller), a doctor's aging mother, play into these deaths? The answer to the puzzling mystery of fragile youth is soon to be revealed.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: On a desperate mission to survive, a young military cadet (Will Wheaton) learns the difference between heroic ideals and the bitter realities of war as he and his dying comrades prepare a strike against the aliens who may have condemn them to death.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: Inventor Dr. Jack Henson (David Hyde Pierce) comes up with a "virtual prison" where criminals serve a life sentence in just a few, cost-efficient hours. When an innocent man's life is at stake, the doctor must submit himself to his own invention.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: In a post-apocalyptic underground bunker, a virtual reality world begins to turn on its inventor (Jon Tenney) after he becomes romantically involved with -- and then spurns -- the holographic interface (Natasha Henstridge) that controls the system.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: A mentally challenged man (Howie Mandel) is made more intelligent by a machine that transfers people's memories and experiences into his head, but kills its victims. And he soon discovers that the mind can be a minefield in The Outer Limits.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: After a couple's son dies, an experimental procedure harvests the boy's nerve cells, allowing the mother to give birth to a genetically identical child. But soon it becomes clear that this fetus is not just identical…it is actually Justin himself.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: A man's family is turned upside down when he discovers that his son's college sweetheart is the same woman he rescued from a secret military experiment twenty years before...only she has not aged a day since. Peter Onorati and Fred Savage star.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: When "the Stream" -- an artificial system providing information to all society members through computer chips implanted in their brains -- begins to malfunction, an unlikely, "primitive" man (George Newbern) may be the mankind's only hope.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: After a chemical war renders the world's population unable to conceive healthy children, a mother and father must escape from a sinister government agency intent on using their miraculously healthy newborn to repopulate the species.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: In a society imprisoned for generations by extraterrestrial who invaded Earth, an electronics expert (Harley Jane Kozak) discovers that not only are her human jailers really machines, but they also have been holding prisoners for nearly a century.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: A preacher descends upon the 18th century town of Heart's Desire and offers to share his extraordinary powers with four outlaws. But who is this stranger and why has he given these outlaws such deadly powers? Caspar Van Dien and Esai Morales star.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: Attempting to deliver serum to a plague-stricken planet, a pilot (Eric McCormack) and his crew crash land on an unknown moon. Bitten by an alien spider while fixing the ship, the pilot's mind wanders between alternate realities…in The Outer Limits.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: A woman unable to feel emotions gets a new lease on life when a brain implant allows her to experience feelings for the first time. But, when the implant malfunctions, driving her towards insanity, she is shocked at the real cause of her problems.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: A remorseless, uncaring scientist (Stephen Lang) and his partner (Michael Ontkean) discover a way to bring life back to the recently deceased. But after the scientist is killed and brought back to life himself, will he choose to live differently?

programme.desc: Baron Greenback challenges Danger Mouse to a duel, where if Danger Mouse wins, Greenback will go straight and be good, but if Greenback wins, Danger Mouse has to quit his job.

programme.desc: Danger Mouse and Penfold must face the demon of the fourth dimension. Danger Mouse is transported onto a This Was Your Life television show.

programme.title: Danger Mouse

programme.title: Bill & Ted's Excellent Adventures

programme.title: Danger Mouse

programme.title: Danger Mouse
programme.desc: Greenback devises a ray that animates London's statues and causes them to wreak havoc.

programme.title: Dragon Ball Z
programme.desc: Goku entrena sin descanso en la nave que le llevará hacia Namek. Como es un astronauta inexperto, la reparación de la nave se convierte en una auténtica aventura, pero eso le permite aumentar su fuerza.
programme.sub-title: ¡Dodoria explota! La temible onda de choque de Vegeta

programme.title: Dragon Ball Z
programme.desc: Vegeta desata el terror en el poblado y se enfrenta a todos los guerreros que le presentan batalla.
programme.sub-title: ¡Huida del planeta en llamas! Un desesperado Kamehameha.

programme.title: Dragon Ball Z
programme.desc: Mientras Goku se entrena en la nave, Kaito se comunica con él y le da una sorpresa increíble. ¡Todos sus amigos están con el maestro! Los espíritus de Yamcha, Chaos, Ten Shin Han y Piccolo están con él.
programme.sub-title: ¡Coraje x 100! Los guerreros se reúnen con Kaio!

programme.title: Dragon Ball Z
programme.desc: Vegeta se encuentra con Zarbon y lecuenta sus planes: ser inmortal y destruir al tirano. Zarbon es el tercer guerrero de la guardia personal de Freezer y no se libra del enfrentamiento contra el guerrero del espacio, que le demuestra sus progresos.

programme.title: Dragon Ball Z
programme.desc: Zarbon pilla a Vegeta por sorpresa porque no espera que el soldado de elite sea capaz de nada mejor. ¡El soldado se transforma en un horrible monstruo ante los asombrados ojos del saiyano
programme.sub-title: ¡Escalofrío! La diabólica transformación del apuesto guerrero Zaabon

programme.title: Dragon Ball Z
programme.desc: Krilín y Denda llegan hasta la residencia del Jefe Supremo sanos y salvos. El padre de todos los habitantes del planeta es un anciano con un gran poder que, además de darle una bola de dragón a Krilín, le despierta el poder que dormía en su interior.
programme.sub-title: ¡Defended el planeta de la esperanza¡. El sorprendente aumento de poder de Klilin

programme.title: Dragon Ball Z
programme.desc: Freezer ordena a Zarbon que recoja el cuerpo de Vegeta que ha quedado en un estado crítico después de su lucha contra la versión transformada del soldado del tirano. Sorprendentemente, las órdenes de Freezer son curarle, a riesgo de la vida de Zarbon
programme.sub-title: Resurrección a las puertas de la muerte. El hombre milagroso, Vegeta

programme.title: Dragon Ball Z
programme.desc: Krilín llega junto a Bulma con la bola de dragón que le ha regalado el Jefe Supremo de los nameks. Pero no se ha dado cuenta que no ha logrado despistar a Vegeta. El saiyano ha descubierto su escondite y también la bola de dragón que tiene.
programme.sub-title: ¡Una fuerza de combate inmensa! Los planes de Freeza se desmoronan

programme.title: Dragon Ball Z
programme.desc: El aguerrido Vegeta se enfrenta otra vez a Zarbon. Pero en esta ocasión, Vegeta ha aprendido a mantener la guardia frente a Zarbon y le obliga a transformarse ante los atónitos ojos de Bulma y Krilín
programme.sub-title: ¡Vuelvo a ser el de siempre! Goku se enfrenta a una gravedad de 100

programme.title: Dragon Ball Z
programme.desc: Freezer intuye la derrota del guerrero Zarbon y monta en cólera. En otra parte de Namek, Vegeta se da cuenta de que le han robado una bola de dragón. ¡Y sospecha del pequeño Son Gohan porque se ha encontrado con él hace poco!
programme.sub-title: ¡El arma secreta de Freeza! Las diabólicas Fuerzas Especiales Ginyu

programme.title: Dragon Ball Z
programme.desc: Goku se dirige hacia el planeta Namek en la nave que el padre de Bulma ha construido para él. Mientras, Bulma se encarga de la bola de dragón que Son Gohan le ha robado a Vegeta, y las desgracias empiezan a sucederse una detrás de otra.
programme.sub-title: ¡Bulma está en peligro! La bola de cuatro estrellas cae en las manos de Freeza.

programme.title: Dragon Ball Z
programme.desc: Bulma sigue en las manos de sus captores y tiene que utilizar todo su ingenio para librarse de ellos.
programme.sub-title: ¡Colisión frontal! El Kame Hame Ha y el Kaioh Ken

programme.title: Dragon Ball Z
programme.desc: Aunque está muerta de miedo, Bulma ha conseguido escapar. ¡Y tiene la bola de dragón! Han pasado cuatro días desde que Krilín y Son Gohan abandonaron el refugio; deciden utilizar su poder y avanzar rápido a sabiendas del riesgo que corren.
programme.sub-title: ¡La batalla definitiva se aproxima! ¡Llegan las Fuerzas Especiales Ginyu!

programme.title: Dragon Ball Z
programme.desc: Las temidas Fuerzas Especiales de Freezer acaban de llegar. Los pobres Krilín, Son Gohan y Bulma tienen que contar... ¡cinco enemigos más! Y Goku aún no ha llegado.
programme.sub-title: ¡Gokū se aproxima a toda velocidad! Hay que escapar de las redes de Freeza

programme.title: Dragon Ball Z
programme.desc: Lo imposible se convierte en realidad cuando Krilín y Son Gohan se ven forzados a colaborar con su mayor enemigo, Vegeta, para tener una oportunidad contra las Fuerzas Especiales
programme.sub-title: ¡¿Truco o súper-magia?! ¡El Sr. Gourd se enfurece!

programme.title: Dragon Ball Z
programme.desc: Los cinco guerreros de las Fuerzas Especiales superan a Vegeta, Krilín y Son Gohan de largo, pero eso no impide que Vegeta luche. Los poderes de las Fuerzas Especiales asombran a nuestros protagonistas.
programme.sub-title: El salvaje Recoom. Es malo, brutal y extravagante

programme.title: Dragon Ball Z
programme.desc: Los guerreros de las Fuerzas Especiales han perdido a uno de sus miembros. Gracias a un ataque combinado, Son Gohan y Krilín han vencido al que dominaba el tiempo. Vegeta hace gala de su poder y se enfrenta a un luchador que parece indestructible
programme.sub-title: ¡No mueras, Gohan! Gokū llega finalmente al campo de batalla

programme.title: Dragon Ball Z
programme.desc: El capitán de las fuerzas especiales le lleva las siete bolas de dragón a Freezer, pero el tirano se enoja porque no sabe como activarlas
programme.sub-title: ¡Una fuerza fuera de lo normal! Gokū, el Super Saiyajin de la leyenda

programme.title: Dragon Ball Z
programme.desc: Goku aterriza en Namek, justo donde su hijo, Krilín y Vegeta han caído malheridos. Goku detecta enseguida a Freezer: ha llegado el momento de demostrar la evolución del guerrero después de su largo entrenamiento en el espacio.
programme.sub-title: ¡Una bola relámpago azul y roja! Jeese y Burtta atacan a Gokū

programme.title: Dragon Ball Z
programme.desc: Una antigua leyenda cuenta que cada mil años despierta un guerrero supersaiyano con poderes increíbles. Vegeta se niega a creer que pueda ser Goku, pero la fuerza de su antiguo adversario le sorprende cada vez más
programme.sub-title: ¡Al fin una confrontación directa! El capitán Ginyu entra en combate

programme.title: Dragon Ball Z
programme.desc: El capitán de las Fuerzas Especiales custodia las bolas de dragón mientras Freezer intenta interceptar a un poderoso guerrero namek. Goku vence fácilmente a sus adversarios y, aunque desea perdonar a los que han perdido, Vegeta no es tan indulgente.
programme.sub-title: ¡Qué fuerza más increíble! Has visto todo el poder de Gokū

programme.title: Dragon Ball Z
programme.desc: Goku sigue combatiendo contra el poderoso capitán de las Fuerzas Especiales, que aún no ha demostrado su verdadero poder, pero ya se ha dado cuenta que Goku, al igual que él, tiene la habilidad de esconder la fuerza a los enemigos
programme.sub-title: ¿Cuál será el resultado de la batalla? La diabólica mano de Freeza se cierra sobre el Saichoro

programme.title: Dragon Ball Z
programme.desc: El gran jefe despierta en Denda su poder interior y le da una misión muy especial. Cuando él falte, deberá convertirse en el líder de su pueblo.
programme.sub-title: ¡Sorpresa! Goku es Ginew y Ginew es Goku

programme.title: Dragon Ball Z
programme.desc: El guerrero más poderoso entre los nameks está dispuesto a enfrentarse él solo a Freezer quien, por primera vez, abandona su cómodo sistema de transporte. No hace más que subestimar a este adversario y se ofrece a luchar con una sola mano.

programme.title: Dragon Ball Z
programme.desc: El capitán de las Fuerzas Especiales decide agotar su última baza: un poder que jamás ha mostrado. Goku ve cómo el capitán se hiere a sí mismo para abandonar el cuerpo en que se encuentra e invadir el de Goku como huésped
programme.sub-title: ¡Ese no soy yo!¡Gohan tienes que golpear a tu padre!

programme.title: Dragon Ball Z
programme.desc: Goku está en el cuerpo moribundo del capitán de las Fuerzas Especiales pero no se rinde y acumula toda su voluntad para ir en busca de su cuerpo. Al llegar a la nave, Krilín y Son Gohan intentan invocar al dragón sagrado.

programme.title: Dragon Ball Z
programme.desc: Son Gohan y Krilín atacan a Genew con todas sus fuerzas para liberar a Goku. Vegeta también ayuda a vencer a Genew, que intenta una vez más el intercambio de cuerpos.
programme.sub-title: Tú que has reunido las siete bolas... di la contraseña.

programme.title: Dragon Ball Z
programme.desc: La avanzada tecnología de la nave de Freezer permitirá que Goku se recupere en menos de una hora. Denda consigue reunirse con Son Gohan y Krilín y entona la letanía mágica para invocar al dragón sagrado.
programme.sub-title: ¡Dios también vuelve a la vida! Piccolo es resucitado por Súper Shenron.

programme.title: Dragon Ball Z
programme.desc: El Dragón Gorunga está a la disposición de Krilín y Son Gohan que formulan sus deseos con Denda como intérprete del idioma namek. Cuando le piden que resucite a todos los que murieron, Gorunga responde que sólo puede resucitar a una persona por deseo
programme.sub-title: ¿El nacimiento del guerrero definitivo? Piccolo y Nail se fusionan

programme.title: Dragon Ball Z
programme.desc: Al resucitar a Piccolo también le devuelven la vida al Todopoderoso. En ese momento llega Vegeta hecho una furia. Cuando Vegeta pide su deseo... Gorunga se volatiliza ante los ojos de los sorprendidos invocadores.
programme.sub-title: ¡La supertransformación de pesadilla! La fuerza de combate de un millón de Freeza

programme.title: Dragon Ball Z
programme.desc: La lucha comienza y nuestros héroes tienen pocas posibilidades. Vegeta le hace frente, pero el tirano es mucho más fuerte y les reserva unas cuantas sorpresas, como una transformación que le convertirá en un ser aún más poderoso
programme.sub-title: ¿Éste es el fin? Gohan es atacado por un poder descomunal

programme.title: Dragon Ball Z
programme.desc: Freeza ha completado la primera transformación y recuerda cómo hizo sucumbir a su padre, el rey, y al planeta entero. Bulma se enfrenta a una manada de dinosaurios sola, Piccolo se dirige hacia Son Gohan y Krilín, esperando no llegar demasiado tarde.
programme.sub-title: ¡La marea cambia de golpe! Piccolo, el guerrero rezagado

programme.title: Dragon Ball Z
programme.desc: Da comienzo la batalla entre el recién llegado Piccolo y Freeza. Tras asimilar al moribundo Nail, el namek ha adquirido un sorprendente poder que le permite enfrentarse de igual a igual contra el todopoderoso tirano espacial.
programme.sub-title: ¡La confianza de Piccolo! Yo seré el que derrote a Freeza

programme.title: Dragon Ball Z
programme.desc: Cuando la balanza parece inclinarse a favor de Piccolo, Freeza sorprende a todos con una segunda transformación. La desbordante fuerza de combate y velocidad de esta nueva forma le permiten propinar una brutal paliza al namek.
programme.sub-title: ¡Únete a la batalla, Goku! La segunda transformación de un Freeza enfurecido

programme.title: Dragon Ball Z
programme.desc: Mientras un enfurecido Gohan contiene a Freeza, Vegeta lleva a cabo un plan desesperado para convertirse en Super Saiyan. Al mismo tiempo, Freeza decide mostrar a sus enemigos el verdadero terror de su forma definitiva
programme.sub-title: ¡Temedme! El desafío de la tercera transformación de Freeza

programme.title: Dragon Ball Z
programme.desc: El poder y la maldad de la forma definitiva de Freeza parecen no tener límites como lo demuestra al asesinar a sangre fría al pequeño Dende y resistir como si nada el ataque de Vegeta a pesar de su desorbitado aumento de poder.
programme.sub-title: La muerte de Dende... ¡Surge, formidable Poder Zenkai!

programme.title: Dragon Ball Z
programme.desc: Vegeta no es rival para Freeza y acaba perdiendo la voluntad de luchar sin que Piccolo, Gohan y Klilyn puedan hacer nada más que observar aterrados. ¿Conseguirá aguantar el tiempo suficiente para que Goku se recupere?
programme.sub-title: ¡Cómo he esperado este momento! Son Gokū se recupera

programme.title: Dragon Ball Z
programme.desc: Goku llega al campo de batalla demasiado tarde para salvar a Vegeta. El príncipe de los saiyans aprovecha sus últimos instantes de vida para revelar un oscuro secreto de su pasado y arrancarle una promesa a Goku.

programme.desc: McKay and Ronan volunteer to assist Dr. Jennifer Keller with a medical follow-up away from Atlantis. Later, when the pair return to her, they are surprised to learn that she left earlier but a search of the village turns up no sign of her.

programme.desc: Stargate SG-1’s Dr. Daniel Jackson (Michael Shanks) travels to Atlantis when his research suggests that a rebellious Ancient scientist named Janus (Gildart Jackson) may have hidden a secret lab somewhere within the city.

programme.title: Stargate Atlantis
programme.desc: Jackson and McKay have reactivated the Attero device, an ancient machine designed to annihilate the Wraith. In doing so, they discover the reason the device was ultimately abandoned… Meanwhile, Todd continues to hold the Daedalus crew captive.

programme.title: Stargate Atlantis
programme.desc: Col. Sheppard and his team locate Dr. Carson Beckett on an alien planet where he is treating a small group of survivors of the Hoffan plague. But that same evening, a party of Wraith warriors arrives, threatening total annihilation.

programme.title: Stargate Universe
programme.desc: After secretly contacting Homeworld Command, Dr. Rush (Robert Carlyle) claims that he has been placed in charge by Gen. O’Neill (Richard Dean Anderson) and that there is no hope of returning to Earth. But his assertions are soon questioned.

programme.title: Stargate Universe
programme.desc: With the air supply failing on the Destiny, a team disembarks to a desert-like planet in search of a mineral needed to scrub the ship's air of carbon dioxide. While one team presses on to find the vital mineral, the other has another goal in mind.

programme.title: Stargate Universe
programme.desc: Using the communications stones, Lt. Scott and Camile Wray use their time back on Earth to visit those they’ve left behind. Aboard Destiny, the crew stumbles upon a piece of Ancient technology that carries the promise of a way home.

programme.title: Stargate Universe
programme.desc: Everyone is shocked when a member of the crew is found dead from a gunshot wound. While it appears to be suicide, the gun is nowhere to be found…until it shows up in Col. Young’s (Louis Ferreira) quarters and he becomes the number one suspect.

programme.title: Stargate Universe
programme.desc: With crew members stranded, Destiny continues to cross from the present galaxy into the next one. Unable to alter the Destiny's course, Dr. Rush calculates the Destiny will fall short of making it to the next galaxy, stranding them indefinitely.

programme.title: Stargate Universe
programme.desc: When Destiny comes upon a heavily damaged ship, Dr. Rush and Col. Young decide to make a dangerous space-suited expedition to the ship. But an unexpected turn of events leaves Dr. Rush and Col. Young stranded aboard the strange vessel.

programme.title: Stargate Universe
programme.desc: Excitement spreads through the ship as Eli believes he’s found a way to dial Earth. But Dr. Rush has serious reservations about abandoning Destiny, and when the crew is interrupted by a distress call, it may just change the plans of the Destiny.

programme.title: Stargate Universe
programme.desc: Greer and Wray find themselves trapped in the midst of an attack when an alien ship carrying a radioactive bomb crashes into Homeworld Command. Meanwhile, Rush (Robert Carlyle) discovers that not everyone wants Greer and Wray back aboard Destiny.

programme.title: Stargate Universe
programme.desc: Destiny discovers the survivors of an interplanetary expedition who claim their civilization, Novus, was founded two thousand years earlier by Destiny’s crew. Suddenly, they are attacked by the Drones who have discovered a way to track Destiny.

programme.title: Stargate Universe

programme.title: Zurück in die Vergangenheit
programme.desc: September 1973: FBI Agent Peter Langley - alias Sam - erhält die Aufgabe, Dana zu beschützen. Die junge Frau möchte gegen ihren ehemaligen Chef, den Drogenschmuggler Nick Kochifos, aussagen. Dieser hat sie schon zweimal ausfindig machen können.

programme.title: Zurück in die Vergangenheit
programme.desc: George erwacht 1970 im Körper von George Washakie. Er wurde mit Georges Großvater ins Gefängnis gebracht, weil sie sich ein Auto "ausgeliehen" haben. Sie können allerdings aus dem Gefängnis fliehen.

programme.title: Zurück in die Vergangenheit
programme.desc: Die Leiche Hilla Danners liegt eines Tages vor dem Leichenbestatter Melvin Spooner, alias Sam. Er sieht anhand der Wunden im Gesicht, dass sie ermordet worden sein muss und beschließt, den Mörder ausfindig zu machen.

programme.title: Zurück in die Vergangenheit
programme.desc: Sam muss ins Jahr 1950 reisen, um in Chicago einen Billard-Spieler und seine Enkelin zu retten. Die Enkelin will aus dem Billardclub einen Blues Club machen und hat dafür einen Kredit aufgenommen.

programme.title: Zurück in die Vergangenheit
programme.desc: Trapezkünstlerin Maria Panzini kam bei einem dreifachen Salto ohne Sicherheitsnetz ums Leben. Laszlo will nicht, dass seine Kinder das gleiche Schicksal erleiden, aber das kann nur Sam verhindern.

programme.title: Zurück in die Vergangenheit
programme.desc: Sam schlüpft am 11. März 1963 in den Körper des Türstehers Buster. Der hat der Kollegin und Stripperin Bunny geholfen, ein Kind zu entführen. Sie hat vorher als Babysitterin auf das Kind aufgepasst.

programme.title: Zurück in die Vergangenheit
programme.desc: Sam landet am 3. Juni 1954 im Körper des Globetrotters Phillip Dumont auf einem Kreuzfahrtschiff. Er muss an seiner Stelle versuchen, seine Ex-Frau Catherine zurückzugewinnen.

programme.title: Zurück in die Vergangenheit
programme.desc: Sam landet am 1. April 1969 in den Klamotten einer Prostituierten auf einer Straße. Als er unter Beschuss gerät, kommt ihm Robert Skaggs zur Hilfe.

programme.title: Zurück in die Vergangenheit
programme.desc: Sam erwacht im Jahre 1957 im Körper von "Captain Galaxy" alias Moe Stein. "Captain Galaxy" mimt den Clown in einer Kindersendung. Er ist sehr schusselig, weshalb er immer wieder bei Menschen aneckt. In seinem Keller baut er an einer Zeitmaschine.

programme.title: Zurück in die Vergangenheit
programme.desc: Sam schlüpft in den Körper des Showtänzers Rod, um so die Tänzerin Diana zu retten. Diese ist in die Prostitution abgerutscht und hat sich mit HIV infiziert. Zuvor ist sie bei einem Vortanzen abgelehnt worden, weil sie taub ist.

programme.title: Zurück in die Vergangenheit
programme.desc: Als Bar-Pianist lebt Sam gefährlich. Er und seine Verflossene geraten ins Visier eines Mörders.

programme.title: Zurück in die Vergangenheit
programme.desc: Sam nimmt die Gestalt von Gilbert Hebert an, um den Mord an seiner Cousine Marsha zu verhindern. Die Prostituierte wurde in Heberts Freudenhaus ums Leben gebracht.

programme.title: Zurück in die Vergangenheit
programme.desc: Am 12. April 1974 schlüpft Sam in den Körper von Sänger Geoffrey `Tonic' Mole. Er soll verhindern, dass der Leadsänger der Glitterrock-Band "King Thunder" ermordet wird.

programme.title: Zurück in die Vergangenheit
programme.desc: Sam schlüpft in den Körper des Kopfgeldjägers Gordon O'Reilly. Er soll Diane Frost, der Unterschlagung vorgeworfen wird, dem Sheriff ausliefern. Sam soll die unschuldige Frau vor dem bevorstehenden Tod retten.

programme.title: Zurück in die Vergangenheit
programme.desc: Die nächste Zeitreise führt Sam in das Jahr 1971 zurück, direkt auf den elektrischen Stuhl. Im Körper von Jesus Ortega wird er beschuldigt, einen Priester bei einem Banküberfall erschossen zu haben.

programme.title: Zurück in die Vergangenheit
programme.desc: Sam reist ins Jahr 1955, wo er sich im Körper des Ringers Terry Sammins befindet. Zusammen mit seinem Bruder Ronnie will er um die Weltmeisterschaft kämpfen. Sam soll allerdings Ronnie vom Kampf abhalten, da dieser unter einem Herzfehler leidet.

programme.title: Zurück in die Vergangenheit
programme.desc: Sam reist in das Jahr 1962 zur Zeit der Kuba-Krise und schlüpft in den Körper von Eddi Elroy. Dieser betreibt mit seinem Bruder Mac einen Handel mit Atombunkern. Sam, alias Eddi, soll Mac davon abhalten, seinen Nachbarn, Burt Rosecranes, umzubringen.

programme.title: Zurück in die Vergangenheit
programme.desc: Sam schlüpft in den Körper von Samuel Beederman, um das Schicksal von Tibby positiv zu beeinflussen. Samuel und Tibby sind in einer Nervenheilanstalt in Behandlung. Sam bringt Tibby das Lesen bei.

programme.title: Zurück in die Vergangenheit
programme.desc: Dieses Mal tauschen Sam und Albert die Rollen und Sam bleibt als Observer in der Gegenwart. Albert reist ins Jahr 1945, wo er soeben als Kriegsveteran Tom in seinen Heimatort zurückgekehrt ist.

programme.title: The Walking Dead

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Enquanto o grupo debate os próximos passos, Rick vaga à procura de um amigo; o governador restaura a ordem em Woodbury e promete punir os responsáveis.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Rick e o grupo têm de fazer uma escolha quando a segurança de todos é ameaçada; Andrea tenta negociar uma trégua, mas o Governador prepara Woodbury para uma guerra.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Percebendo que está em desvantagem para enfrentar o Governador, Rick leva Carl e Michonne em uma expedição para conseguir mais armas. Quando chegam à cidade, Rick encontra um velho conhecido.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Para evitar mais mortes sem sentido, Rick e o Governador se encontram com a esperança de estabelecer um tratado de paz, mas suas personalidades são tão diferentes quanto seus métodos.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: O Governador persegue um dissidente fugitivo; um traidor aproveita-se da ausência do Governador e tenta sabotar seus planos.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Rick se depara com um problema grave: se ele e o grupo realmente quiserem uma trégua com o Governador, eles terão que fazer um enorme sacrifício.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Rick e o grupo pensam seriamente se querem ou não defender a prisão quando um ataque do Governador se aproxima.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Rick e o grupo estão bem próximos de viver a vida ideal na prisão. Resta saber se eles vão conseguir manter a humanidade com a chegada de um novo e terrível mal.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Rick Grimes e seu grupo de sobreviventes não enfrentam apenas os mortos, mas também uma nova ameaça: os vivos. Eles lutam para garantir sua subsistência, que foi conseguida com muito custo.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Em uma decisão arriscada, um grupo deixa a prisão em busca de valiosos suprimentos. Os membros remanescentes são forçados a lidarem com perdas recentes, cujas consequências não serão facilmente superadas.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Os sobreviventes que embarcam na missão para obter suprimentos são testados e precisam superar perigosos e aterrorizantes obstáculos. A situação na prisão piora, deixando os nervos de todos à flor da pele.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Diferentes inimigos pressionam Rick e o grupo; os sobreviventes e a prisão podem chegar a um ponto de ruptura.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Depois de sua derrota em Woodbury, o Governador vagueia sem rumo até que ele encontra uma família passando necessidade.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: O Governador planeja os próximos passos enquanto ele, Lilly, Tara e Meghan se adaptam a um novo ambiente.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: O Governador motiva as pessoas a ocupar o acampamento nos arredores da prisão; um flashback mostra o nocaute de Michonne atrás de uma árvore; com as recentes ameaças do surto de gripe finalmente sob controle, Rick e o grupo sentem que estão seguros.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Rick e Carl buscam abrigo, enquanto Rick é forçado a lidar com antigas feridas; os residentes da prisão consideram se apenas a sobrevivência será o suficiente.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Beth tem um diário sobre sua vida antes da prisão; zumbis perseguem Beth e Daryl após um ataque do Governador; um par de tênis e pegadas na areia indicam que Luke e Molly ainda vivem; Lizzie e Mika vão atrás de Tyreese na floresta.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Enquanto Carl e Michonne buscam suprimentos, Rick precisa escapar de uma gangue de saqueadores. Longe dali, Glenn e Tara se unem a três desconhecidos em uma estranha missão.
